name: Odevixibat

fda.text: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Hepatoxicity : Obtain baseline liver tests and monitor patients frequently for the first 6 to 8 months after starting therapy, and as clinically indicated thereafter during treatment. If liver test abnormalities or signs of clinical hepatitis occur, consider dose reduction or treatment…

summary: A warning for Odevixibat involves hepatotoxicity, which means liver damage, so patients need liver tests before starting and frequent monitoring for the first 6 to 8 months of treatment [3]. If liver tests become abnormal or signs of hepatitis (liver inflammation) appear, doctors may consider lowering the dose or stopping treatment [3]. In addition, a small computer model, rather than tests on people, gave this drug a medium score of 53 for the liver and a low score of 47 for the heart [M].
